summary: Solid TypeScript/Bun implementation with good separation of concerns and comprehensive CI testing. YAML workflow is well-structured with pinned actions and least-privilege permissions. Issues: (1) workflow's compliance-check job always exits 0, preventing build failure on denied licenses—intentional for warning-only behavior but worth clarifying; (2) hardcoded fixture paths in env vars reduce flexibility; (3) test-harness.ts is complex (~100 lines) but appropriately detailed for act integration testing. No code duplication, strong type safety, graceful error handling throughout.
